> 第570章 凯旋（第1页）
八大异族核心据点尽数拔除，域外战场再无异族抗衡之力。
剩余散落的中小型据点和边缘星域，皆是无兵无将，无险可守的残余之地，人族大军很快完成了清剿。
林渊目光远眺茫茫星海来时的方向。
他旋身转身，衣袖拂过漫天星光，下令班师。
此番归途，众人心境与出征之时，判若云泥。
数月之前，大军奔赴域外战场，人人除了激动热血沸腾以外，也做好了遇到最坏情况的准备。
每个将士都做好了埋骨星海，战死沙场的准备。
毕竟贪生怕死的人也不会前来主动参战。
而今凯旋，人人昂首挺胸，笑容满面，眼底藏着历经血战的笃定与荣光。
他们跟随林渊殿下击溃万族联军，踏平异族圣地，带着满载而归的无上战果，活着回到故土。
这份踏实与骄傲，胜过世间一切荣光。
上百位准帝强者位列长空，气势巍峨。
亿万精锐修士阵列规整，军纪森严，密密麻麻的战舰飞舟悬浮星河，连绵不绝，满载无尽资源辎重。
整支大军绵延数亿里，横亘浩瀚星空，如一条蛰伏万古，一朝腾飞的九天巨龙，气势磅礴，震慑星海。
青龙副殿主沐衍随队而行，回望身后望不到尽头的凯旋大军，轻声感慨，语带万千唏嘘道：
“殿下一手倾覆域外格局，此战之后，域外战场的格局就此大变！”
白虎副殿主白凛霜立于一侧，眸光锐利，望着异族逃窜的苍茫星域，沉声道：
“域外万族在域外战场的势力被殿下一人彻底解决。

从今往后，域外战场其他异族，皆要看我人族脸色行事。”
朱雀副殿主唇角噙着一抹浅淡笑意，看透局势：
“虫族母皇陨落，其他八大异族尽数逃窜，据点全灭。
这个消息应该可以很快传遍域外战场了。”
域外战场连接着不知道多少世界，还有大大小小各种种族，种类数以万计。
一般大致划分为：下等族群，中等族群，上等族群，顶级族群。
域外战场的种族众多，公认的十大顶级族群便是：
神族，人族，鬼族，灵族，冥族，虫族，妖族，晶族，狱族，星族。
很多或者中小族群要么是顶级族群的附庸，要么是顶级族群的奴隶，又或者是已经被灭绝。
上等族群为了生存不得不抱团取暖，组成了个联盟，每年都要给各大顶级族上供大笔资源。
由于上等族群联盟占据的是比较偏僻的蛮荒之地，没什么油水可以捞。
加上数百个上等族群联手，也算是个有些难啃的猎物。
比起竭泽而渔，还是养着，接受供奉，细水长流更不错。
所以十大顶级族群也没有围剿上等族群联盟。
弱肉强食，便是域外战场的生存法则。
想必这些小心翼翼在域外战场生存下来的上等族群联盟。
还有众多中小族群应该很快就能够得到消息了。
至于消息不灵通比较闭塞的中小族群们，早就被域外战场残酷的规则给淘汰了。

> Chapter 570 Triumph (Page 1)
All the eight major alien core strongholds have been eradicated, and there is no longer any alien power to compete on the battlefield outside the territory.
The remaining scattered small and medium-sized strongholds and edge star fields were all remnant places without soldiers, generals, and no danger to defend. The human army quickly completed the clearing.
Lin Yuan looked far away in the direction where the vast sea of ​​stars came from.
He turned around, his sleeves brushing against the stars in the sky, and gave the order to the class.
On this return trip, everyone's mood was completely different from when they set off for the expedition.
A few months ago, the army rushed to the battlefield outside the territory. In addition to being excited and excited, everyone was also prepared for the worst-case scenario.
Every soldier is ready to bury their bones in the sea of ​​​​stars and die on the battlefield.
After all, people who are greedy for life and afraid of death will not come to actively participate in the war.
Now that they have triumphed, everyone holds their heads high, smiles on their faces, and their eyes contain the determination and glory that have gone through bloody battles.
They followed His Highness Lin Yuan to defeat the coalition forces of all races, conquered the holy land of foreign races, and returned to their homeland alive with the supreme victory.
This solidity and pride are better than all the glory in the world.
Hundreds of powerful quasi-emperors lined up in the sky with majestic momentum.
Hundreds of millions of elite monks are arrayed in an orderly manner, military discipline is strict, and densely packed battleships and flying boats are floating in the galaxy, in an endless stream, loaded with endless resources and baggage.
The entire army stretches for hundreds of millions of miles across the vast starry sky. It is like a nine-sky dragon that has been dormant for eternity and then takes off. It is so majestic that it frightens the sea of ​​stars.
Qinglong Deputy Palace Master Mu Yan followed the team, looked back at the endless victorious army behind him, sighed softly, and said with thousands of sighs:
"His Highness has single-handedly overturned the pattern outside the territory. After this battle, the pattern of the battlefield outside the territory has changed drastically!"
Bai Linshuang, the deputy master of the White Tiger Palace, stood on one side, with sharp eyes, looking at the vast star field where the alien races were fleeing, and said in a deep voice:
“The forces of all races outside the territory on the battlefield outside the territory were completely eliminated by His Highness alone.
From now on, other foreign races on the battlefield outside the territory will all act based on the face of our human race. "
There was a faint smile on the lips of the deputy master of the Suzaku Palace, seeing through the situation:
"The mother queen of the Zerg tribe fell, the other eight alien tribes all fled, and all their strongholds were destroyed.
This news should soon spread throughout the battlefields outside the territory. "
The extraterrestrial battlefield connects countless worlds, and there are various races, large and small, with tens of thousands of species.
Generally speaking, they are roughly divided into: lower ethnic group, middle ethnic group, upper ethnic group, and top ethnic group.
There are many races in the extraterrestrial battlefield, and the top ten recognized top races are:
God Clan, Human Clan, Ghost Clan, Spirit Clan, Hades Clan, Zerg Clan, Monster Clan, Crystal Clan, Hell Clan, Star Clan.
Many or small and medium ethnic groups are either vassals of the top ethnic groups, slaves of the top ethnic groups, or have been exterminated.
In order to survive, the upper-class tribes had to stay together and formed an alliance, which provided large sums of resources to the top tribes every year.
Since the superior ethnic group alliance occupies a relatively remote and wild land, there is little profit to be made.
Coupled with hundreds of superior ethnic groups joining forces, it can be considered a somewhat difficult prey.
Rather than draining the lake and fishing, it is better to raise it, accept offerings, and let the water flow slowly.
Therefore, the ten top ethnic groups did not encircle and suppress the alliance of superior ethnic groups.
The law of survival on the battlefield outside the territory is the law of the jungle.
Presumably, these are alliances of superior ethnic groups that carefully survived on the battlefield outside the territory.
There are also many small and medium-sized ethnic groups who should be able to get the news soon.
As for the small and medium-sized ethnic groups who are ill-informed and relatively isolated, they have long been eliminated by the cruel rules of the foreign battlefield.
Sure enough, the news that the human race defeated the coalition forces of all races and captured the nine top alien imperial cities,
